source: MHCLG, Council Taxbase 2025 in England, local authority level data (CTB returns, snapshot 6 October 2025; published 6 November 2025, revised 21 January 2026). Single adult 25% discount is Table 1.08; the denominator is Table 1.07 (chargeable dwellings).
caveat: Counts dwellings, not people. The single adult discount is the cleanest available signal of single-person occupancy. The separate discounts for dwellings where all but one resident is disregarded (Table 1.09) or all residents are disregarded (Table 1.10) cover students, people who are severely mentally impaired and similar cases, and are shown separately. Snapshot 6 October 2025.
